releaseNotes: Fix: brightness on the 5" Elecrow Advance hardware v1.1 -- low settings (1-9%) no longer turn the screen off, and the brightness steps now use the display's own five levels. Thanks to the customer who tracked this down.

Fix: the 4.3" and 5" Elecrow Advance displays no longer get stuck showing horizontal streaks with WiFi on -- the display now re-syncs after every card. A brief glitch can still show while a card changes.

New: WiFi pairing is now stored on the display itself -- once a display is set up for WiFi from a computer, other computers running Pixelcade on the same network can no longer take it over. Setting up its WiFi from another computer over USB moves it to that computer; turning WiFi off clears it.
New: displays on WiFi now announce themselves on the network every few seconds, so Pixelcade finds them reliably (and Companion can list displays on your network, including ones not paired yet).
Fix: USB now stays at full speed while a display is also connected over WiFi (it used to drop to 115200).
Change: the 2.8" display's boot screen now says "(Resistive)" and the Sunton 5" says "(Sunton)".
Fix: cards could get corrupted or lost over USB when a display had joined WiFi but was still receiving cards over USB -- the serial receive buffer overflowed during WiFi activity.
Fix: less display noise on the 5"/7" displays with WiFi on (larger display bounce buffer). The 5" Elecrow Advance can still show occasional streaks with cards over WiFi; USB is unaffected.
Change: the 5" Elecrow Advance now uses 1.5M USB (was 2M) -- 2M occasionally dropped bytes on this board.
Fix: turning WiFi off from Companion now fully shuts the radio off (the 2.1" round display restarts to do this).
Change: the red 5" Elecrow display is now called "Elecrow Basic" on its boot screen.

New: WiFi -- most displays can now receive cards over WiFi instead of USB (set it up once over USB from Sidekick settings in Companion). Includes the M5Stack Tab5 and the ESP32-P4 displays, which update their built-in WiFi chip automatically the first time.
New: faster USB on most displays (1.5M-2M baud, up from 115200-610000) and faster JPEG decoding on the ESP32-S3 displays -- cards change noticeably faster.
New: added support for the Elecrow CrowPanel 2.1" round display (esp32-2-elecrow-round) -- cards are resized to fit the round screen, and turning the dial switches cards.
New: added support for the Elecrow CrowPanel Advanced 10.1" ESP32-P4 display (esp32-10-elecrow), including its built-in speakers.
New: added support for the Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 3.5" (esp32-3-elecrow-advance) and 4.3" (esp32-4-elecrow-advance) displays.
New: added support for the red Elecrow 5" display (esp32-5-elecrow) -- different hardware from the Elecrow Advance and AI 5" displays.
New: added support for the Sunton ESP32-2432S024C 2.4" capacitive display (esp32-2432s024c).
Fix: display noise on the RGB displays (5"/7"/Elecrow Advance) when WiFi is on.
Fix: turning WiFi off from Companion now fully shuts the radio off.
New: added support for the Sunton ESP32-4827S043C display (esp32-4827s043c) -- 4.3" 480x272, capacitive touch.
New: added support for the Sunton ESP32-3248S035C display (esp32-3248s035c) -- the capacitive-touch sibling of the existing 3.5" display (esp32-3), which uses resistive touch instead.
New: added support for the Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4.3" display (esp32-4-waveshare) -- display and touch (audio/camera not yet supported).

New: added firmware-update-over-USB support for the Elecrow CrowPanel AI 5.0" and Waveshare 4.3" displays -- both boards' USB OTG port can't reach the normal ROM-bootloader flashing path, so updates now push over the same USB connection used for normal operation instead.

Fix: the Elecrow CrowPanel AI 5.0" display always reported the same USB serial number ('0') for every unit, making it impossible to tell two connected units apart -- fixed with a firmware-reported per-unit identity query.
Fix: the AMOLED 1.91" display (LILYGO T-Display-S3-AMOLED) needed its BOOT button held to flash, unlike other displays -- now flashes normally.
Fix: eliminated screen tearing on full-screen art (Fan Art/Screenshot) on the RGB-parallel 5"/7" displays (esp32-5, esp32-7-elecrow, esp32-7-sunton) via double-buffered frame delivery.
Fix: screen rotation and Flip 180° on those same displays, broken by an early version of the tearing fix above -- both now display correctly again.
Fix: esp32-7-sunton was never actually covered by the RGB-parallel tearing protection at all despite shipping since 1.0.16 -- it's now correctly included alongside the other two displays.

New: added support for the Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 5.0" display's older hardware v1.1 revision (esp32-5-elecrow-advance-v1-1) -- it controls backlight/buzzer differently than the v1.2/v1.3 revision, so pick the matching one when flashing (check the small hardware revision marking on your board). Flashing the wrong revision's firmware leaves the screen black even though it's actually working underneath.

Improvement: the Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 5.0" boot splash and model ID now say which hardware revision (v1.1 vs v1.3) the firmware was built for, so it's visible on the device itself, not just in the catalog.
New: added support for the Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 5.0" display (esp32-5-elecrow-advance) -- a different 5" panel than the existing Sunton-based display, so pick the right one when flashing.
Improvement: boot screen now explains how to connect when a Sidekick display hasn't paired with Pixelcade yet.
New: added a power-off button to the 10.1" (Guition) display's boot screen, since it runs on battery and the physical button doesn't power it off.
New: added support for the Sidekick 10.1" (Guition) display -- touch and built-in speaker both included.
Improvement: raised the USB-serial speed on the 2.8" and 3.5" displays (esp32-2, esp32-3) from 115200 to 750000 baud -- over 6x faster transfer of game art and menus to those displays.
